mapper.sql: id, owner_id AS ownerId, name, body, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM note_template WHERE owner_id IS NULL ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_template (id, owner_id, name, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{body}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE note_template SET name = #{name}, body = #{body}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM note_template WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
